toolchainNotes: Use the exact packageManager version. The verified machine pnpm.cmd entry is C:/Users/pengj/Tools/MarkTextDevelopment/pnpm.cmd.

Git-shell commit hooks need a pnpm launcher and Git >=2.32. The machine default Git 2.16 cannot run lint-staged 17; use an already-installed supported Git in the task process instead of disabling hooks.

Pandoc oracle tests were verified with Pandoc 3.13. Anaconda Pandoc 2.11 parses the nested-list fixture differently; use the verified version and rerun rather than changing the assertion or skipping the test.
